answer: Each identity must fund a vault: a time-locked deposit priced at C*n, n being active identities, fixed by protocol. Reputation signal enters only through one inlet per vault, an enforced channel converting matured lock-time into voting weight; vaults cannot merge, split, or transfer balances, and the maturity clock restarts on owner change. N sybil puppets each pay C*n in full, no bulk discount, while an honest user funds one vault once. Cost grows linearly with n, and binding the non-resettable clock blocks parallel re-registration and deposit pooling.
